notes.title: Bugfixes!
notes.content:
Tonight's update fixes two issues:
1. The music room track list once again scrolls with the cursor.
2. I'm quite sure that I finally pinned down and fixed the softlock issue that has been plaguing the game since release.

As always, please report any issues you encounter, new or old, and thank you for your support!

notes.title: End of Year Update
notes.content: This update upgrades the game to the most recent Unity engine, and hopefully fixes a bug preventing the title screen from loading after the logos.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content: I pushed out a minor update today, to hopefully resolve a black screen issue when resizing the game window. A recent Unity release fixed a bug that sounds related to the report I received and though I couldn't reproduce it, there's no harm in updating the Unity player anyway. Please let me know if the black screen issue continues to be a problem for any of you.

notes.title: Yukari Version 1.1 is live!
notes.content:
Hey everybody, version 1.1 is out! Here's the changes:
1. Fix to a small graphical glitch in relation to tall gaps
2. Two more music tracks to choose from (each with two versions)
3. You can now change your music during the game from the pause screen, switching to another one of your three presets.
